configurations.name: uniliv-api
runtimeArgs: set -a; . ./.env; set +a; export PORT=8090; exec pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run dev

configurations.name: uniliv-web
runtimeArgs: _P="$PORT"; set -a; . ./.env; set +a; export PORT="${_P:-3000}" BASE_PATH=/ API_PROXY_TARGET=http://localhost:8090; exec pnpm --filter @workspace/uniliv-admin run dev
